text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Running beside the water feels
great.
There's a cool breeze and a lovely
smell in the
air... Wait!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! This is an emergency! I see a
kebab stand
over there!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Urk! It smells so delicious... What should
I do?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ughhh... Oooh... Okay, fine. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run and run until the aroma
fades from
my memory!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure fate will bring us together
again
someday!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fighting through sweat and tears, Oguri
Cap remains focused on her running. In
the end, she
manages to get back to her
target weight.
